heroes.name: Mushy & Shroom

skills.name: Perfect Copy
skills.activation_condition: Health fully restored for the first time
skills.description:
Conjures an inactive Shroom with a portion of its health missing. The copy has the hero's stats from the battle’s start. It can be targeted by attacks, offensive spells, and healing spells.
When the Shroom’s health is fully replenished for the first time, it activates. After that, it can attack and use all skills learned by the hero, but it won't be able to replenish energy.
You can summon no more than 5 Shrooms.

skills.name: Branching Mycelium
skills.health_basis: Hero health at the start of battle
skills.description:
Conjures mycelium with 3 inactive Spore Mushrooms with a portion of their health missing. They can be targeted by attacks, offensive spells, and healing spells. Their max health is 30% of the hero's health at the battle’s start.
Once the mushroom's health is fully replenished, it runs towards the enemies and explodes, dealing damage and spreading a Mushroom Spore cloud within a short range. The cloud silences those caught within its range for 4 seconds.
Nearby enemies not affected by Mushroom Spores yet are prioritized when selecting the target.

skills.name: Rotting Seeds
skills.healing_accumulation_period: Since the previous activation of this skill
skills.description: Damages the nearest enemy. The damage is increased for each point of healing received by allies since this skill was last activated.

skills.name: Wild Growth
skills.description:
Passive skill. Mushy heals inactive Shrooms and Spore Mushrooms.
This effects stacks for every active Shroom on the battlefield.

class_skill.name: Armor and Magic Defense Protection
class_skill.target: Ally with the lowest health percentage, including Mushy and Shroom
class_skill.description: Temporarily increases the target's armor and magic defense. The bonus scales with the tank's maximum health.

skills.name: Voracious Spores
skills.target: Enemy with the highest maximum health
skills.description: Starting 5 seconds into battle and every 12 seconds afterward, damages the enemy with the highest maximum health and steals maximum health equal to 50% of the damage dealt.
skills.alexandre_tips: Mushy & Shroom drain their enemies' health and restore their own: opponents grow weaker while our Tank grows tougher! The longer the battle lasts, the harder they are to defeat!

skills.name: Perfect Copy
skills.description: Shrooms receive the relic when they activate and begin using Voracious Spores 5 seconds later.
skills.alexandre_tips: It's simple: the little Shrooms created by the first skill now get the Relic too and use Voracious Spores! The Shrooms grow stronger - and, most importantly, unleash several times as many attacks. Watch enemy health bars melt away!

skills.name: Wild Growth
skills.description: Whenever Mushy or an active Shroom receives healing, their magic penetration increases for 4 seconds. This effect stacks for each active Shroom on the battlefield.
skills.alexandre_tips: Healing now helps pierce enemy magic defense! Each time the Hero or Shrooms receive healing, they gain bonus Magic Penetration equal to 10% of Magic Attack for 4 seconds. These effects stack, so you can keep multiple buffs active at once soon after the battle begins!

skills.name: Mycelial Echo
skills.description: Whenever an enemy is healed, Mushy and all Shrooms, including inactive Shrooms, copy 50% of that healing onto themselves. Healing copied by an equivalent ability does not trigger this effect.
skills.alexandre_tips: The cherry on top and a powerful counter to enemy healers! Mushy copies 50% of every heal on the enemy team to restore health to themselves and Shrooms. Each of these heals also triggers the previous ability!

relic.overview: Want to grow an entire mushroom army? Get Mushy & Shroom's Relic and unleash their full power! More healing, stronger Shrooms, and increasing Magic Penetration - your enemies are in for trouble! Even enemy healing works in your favor: Mushy copies it to heal themselves and their Shrooms.

relic_progression.alexandre_tips: Sem a relíquia da Mushy, esse time foi mal e perdeu contra a composição adversária. Depois de ativar a relíquia no nível 1, já houve uma mudança: o time venceu todas as batalhas realizadas nesse teste.

Com a relíquia no nível 1, o time venceu todas as batalhas contra a composição com Julius, Crow, Polaris e Peech. Ao testar contra outros times, com Satori e Leonel, perdeu algumas batalhas. Depois de subir a relíquia para o nível 10, houve uma melhora: Mushy ficou mais ofensiva, passou a tankar mais e conseguiu se sair bem sem um tanque secundário. Também apresentou bons resultados em times com Mojo.
notes: O quinto integrante da composição adversária não foi informado no relato referente a este nível.

relic_progression.alexandre_tips: Esse time ficou muito bom: Mushy não só tankou, como também se beneficiou do buff da Miu e causou mais dano. Também foi bem com Leonel e Mojo. Nos meus testes, ela combinou bem com Miu.

Com a relíquia no nível 30, Mushy melhorou muito nas batalhas: conseguiu tankar muito mais e apresentou melhores resultados em times variados. Na Arena, contra times meta, se saiu bem na maioria dos casos.

game_mode_tests.alexandre_tips: Mushy já era boa contra as Hidras antes das relíquias. Com a relíquia no nível 30, ficou ainda melhor e causou mais dano.
Mesmo sem habilidades de Reino, Mushy já era boa nas batalhas desse modo. Com a relíquia no nível 30, ficou ainda melhor tanto no PvE quanto no PvP do Reino.
team_tips: em arena além dos times acima ela também se saiu bem com: Eva(taliman1), Guus(talisman2), Crow(talisman1),  Mushy & Shroom(taliman1) e Julius(taliman2) ou Eva, Guus, Crow, Byrna, Mushy & Shroom. Adicionando Mojo ou Alvanor também fica bom mas como meu Mojo e meu Alvanor estão fracos em poder para uso na arena ou optei por testalos só no treinamento.
contra times do chaos Cleaver, Electra, byrna, dorian, kendle usei Eva(taliman1), guus(talisman1), byrna(talisman2), tristan(talisman1), Mushy & Shroom(taliman1)

contra times do chaos Cleaver, byrna, dorian, kendle, Aidan usei guus(talisman1), byrna(talisman2), tristan(talisman1), Mushy & Shroom(taliman1), Luther(talisman1) e venci times com mais de 150k de poder de diferença na arena e ainda com inimigo usando reliquia dourada nivel 30. Além disso esse time também conseguiu vencer o time de Chaos com Electra que antes eu só vencia com Eva.

notes: Initial stats are raw starting values before level growth and upgrades.
Promotion and equipped-item bonuses are listed separately and exclude derived attributes.
Artifact values use level 100 and six stars; the weapon grants a temporary team buff.
Non-default skin totals include their purchase cost.
Lunar Skin lists its base bonus separately from the doubled Skin+ bonus.
Crimson Grove Skin lists its base bonus separately from the doubled Skin+ bonus.
Summoned Shrooms and Spore Mushrooms can be targeted by attacks, offensive spells, and healing spells.
Max-stat comparisons use one talisman at a time. Collection bonuses and Realm research settings for these totals are unspecified.
Max stats include the level 30 relic, Lunar Skin+ and Crimson Grove Skin+; relic stat bonuses are cumulative across all relic levels.

names.ja: マッシーとシュルーム

heroes.team_tips: Healers are key to helping Mushy & Shroom thrive: they keep them going until 4-5 little Shrooms are ready to overwhelm the enemy with powerful attacks. Add a damage dealer to complete the lineup: Mojo is a great choice, as his Artifact Weapon increases Magic Penetration even further.
